TA Instruments DSC 2500 (Differential scanning calorimetry)
TA Instruments DSC 2500 (Differential scanning calorimetry)
Differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) for measurement of heat flow into or out of a sample
Temperature range: -90 to 400 °C
Specific heat capacity measurement
54-Position Autosampler
Nitrogen and air gas environments
Modulated DSC (MDSC)
Photocalorimeter attachment (User must supply OmniCure S2000 light source)
